name: Freshworks Freddy AI
pricing_tiers: Freshdesk (support): Free (up to 10 agents), Growth $15/agent/month, Pro $49/agent/month, Enterprise $79/agent/month. Freddy AI included in Pro+ plans. Freddy Copilot add-on: starting at $29/agent/month. Freshsales (CRM): Free, Growth $9/user/month, Pro $39/user/month, Enterprise $69/user/month. Freshservice (ITSM): starting $19/agent/month.
free_tier_available: yes — Freshdesk Free (up to 10 agents, basic Freddy AI features); Freddy Copilot free trial available
latest_major_release: Freddy AI enhancements 2025-2026: Freddy Copilot (autonomous AI agent for support), AI-powered ticket summarization, sentiment analysis v2, self-service chatbot improvements, 72,000 businesses milestone (April 2026)
key_capabilities: AI ticket routing and prioritization, automated responses/suggested replies, sentiment analysis, self-service chatbots (Freddy AI bots), ticket summarization, Freddy Copilot (autonomous support agent), knowledge base article suggestions, predictive analytics for support trends, AI-powered CSAT prediction
integrations: native Freshworks suite (Freshdesk, Freshsales, Freshservice, Freshmarketer, Freshchat); 1,000+ apps via Freshworks Marketplace; Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Salesforce, Shopify, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Zoom; open API
smb_onboarding_time: hours to 1 day (guided setup; Freddy AI auto-activates on Pro+; chatbot builder is visual/drag-drop)
mobile_support: Freshdesk mobile app (iOS/Android) with Freddy AI features; Freshchat mobile SDK for in-app customer messaging; mobile push notifications with AI-prioritized alerts
estimated_smb_users: 72,000+ businesses using Freshworks (2026); strong SMB focus — 80% of customers are SMBs; 250,000+ total Freshworks customers across all products
market_differentiator: best value AI-powered customer support for SMBs — Freddy AI included in Pro plan at $49/agent/month (vs competitors charging $50-100+ add-on for AI); unified platform (support + sales + marketing + ITSM); easiest setup among helpdesk AIs
key_competitors: Zendesk AI, Intercom Fin, HubSpot Service Hub, Salesforce Service Cloud Einstein, Zoho Desk Zia
typical_roi_claim: Freshworks claims 30% reduction in ticket volume via self-service, 25% faster first response time, 20% improvement in CSAT scores with Freddy AI; customers report 10+ hrs/week saved on ticket handling
smb_adoption_trend: growing — 72,000 businesses milestone (2026) shows strong SMB traction; Freddy Copilot launch expanding AI capabilities; pricing advantage over Zendesk/Intercom driving SMB wins
notable_smb_case_studies: E-commerce SMB reduced ticket backlog 40% using Freddy self-service bots; SaaS company used Freddy Copilot to automate 30% of L1 support; small retailer used sentiment analysis to catch unhappy customers before churn
funding_to_date: Freshworks: $720M+ annual revenue (2025); IPO September 2021 at $10B valuation; $484M total VC funding pre-IPO (Accel, Tiger Global, Sequoia, CapitalG)
partner_ecosystem: 1,000+ Freshworks Marketplace apps; global partner network (resellers, SIs, MSPs); App developer program; SMB-focused partner program
community_support: Freshworks Community (forums, 100K+ members), Freshworks Academy (free training), extensive documentation, Freshworks Refresh annual conference, active YouTube channel
